From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps — economic buyer & procurement intro (Acme Corp)

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Call recap:
- Use case: product search and chat assistant for Acme’s customer portal (high throughput, sub-200ms p99 requirement for short queries).
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: latency, cost per 1M tokens, and compliance (data residency + audit logs).
- Current timeline: evaluation this quarter, potential pilot in Q3.

Open items / asks from your side:
1) Confirm economic buyer and budget owner for FY28 (who approves the spend).
2) Procurement/legal contact for security/compliance questionnaire and contract redlines.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- I’ve attached a 1-pager that summarizes Redwood’s hosted API vs Dedicated options and a starter pricing matrix (attachment: redwood-pricing-1pager.pdf).
- If you can intro the economic buyer and procurement contact, we’ll propose a short (30m) alignment call to walk through budgeting and procurement steps.
- Rishi (cc’d) can join for any technical questions on latency and deployment options.

Proposed times for that alignment call (PT): Wed 5/26 10:00-10:30 or Thu 5/27 11:00-11:30 — happy to adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — great summary. 

Quick answers: 
- Economic buyer / budget owner is Dana Pierce (VP Finance). She signs off on platform-level commitments and pilots >$100k.
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com (I’ve CC’d them). They handle legal/POs and standard security questionnaires.
- Ballpark budget: we’re planning a $200k–$300k evaluation/pilot budget for FY28 (subject to Dana’s approval).
- Other stakeholders: SRE and Security will want a short technical review (Rishi should be good for that).

Can you send a short 2–3 slide summary of the offering and a pricing snippet we can share with Dana and procurement? Also any references for similar retail deployments would help.

Jordan
